case.title: Which cancelled entry task left the Connection reused by an uncommitted transaction?
case.title_zh: 后续事务未提交，Connection 之前由哪个取消的入口任务使用？

findings.observation: One real transaction-entry cancellation at affected client checkout99356800 leaves the reused Connection at transaction depth1/INTRANS. A later transaction context exits normally, but the same Connection sees1 inserted row and an independent Connection sees0. Explicit rollback raises ProgrammingError. The successful process exits0 and connections/table/private PostgreSQL are cleaned up. Later-batch startup through success takes28.79s; one preceding observer failure in that batch occurred before cancellation.
findings.interpretation: Generic CoroPerf Task creation plus a file-scoped cancellation exception observation restores launch_interrupted_entry. An API-boundary observation after the later transaction exits restores launch_reuse_check. Both helpers are absent from current observation stacks and present in the causal stacks. An explicit Connection/Task observer independently binds the cancelled-entry Task, later reuse Task and rollback failure to the same actual Connection, showing depth1/INTRANS across phases. The two selected joins are3→5 and29→31. A later cleanup Task reuses the reuse Task address, but its distinct runtime generation prevents joining their records.
findings.limits: This tests exact checkout99356800e90aa0e7b604f652d714ef0f33422b47 using cached CPython3.14.3/PostgreSQL17.1/pure-Python libpq, whereas the report used3.14.8/18.4. The checkout reads version3.3.9 from installed distribution metadata; this is not a released3.3.9 behavior claim. Connection and context-manager wrapper identities require the explicit API observer; generic Task ancestry does not infer shared resources or hidden AsyncTransaction identity. Submission helpers are introduced for this standalone harness. The source already describes stack cleanup; the added diagnostic facts are historical callers and observed cross-phase resource state. Two earlier observer failures are retained, one in b14 and one in b15; neither reached cancellation. No successful scenario replay, nested-savepoint test, alternate server/implementation/version or fix run. The later reuse block runs in a separate Task for this controlled attribution component; the original report runs that block inline in main. No original production Task topology is claimed.

case.symptom_zh: 受影响 client 提交99356800 的一次真实事务入口取消，使连接保留事务深度1/INTRANS。后续事务上下文正常退出，但同一 Connection 看见1行 INSERT，独立 Connection 看见0行；显式 rollback 抛出 ProgrammingError。成功进程退出0，连接、表和私有 PostgreSQL 均清理。后续批次从开始到成功28.79秒；同批更早的一次观察器失败发生在取消之前。
case.reasoning_zh: 通用 CoroPerf Task 创建与文件范围取消异常观察恢复 launch_interrupted_entry，后续事务退出后的 API 边界观察恢复 launch_reuse_check。两个辅助入口均不在当前观察栈中，而在 causal 栈中恢复。额外的 Connection/Task 观察把取消入口任务、后续复用任务与 rollback 失败独立接到同一真实 Connection，跨阶段记录到深度1/INTRANS。目录选取3→5、29→31两条创建关联。稍后的清理 Task 复用了复用任务的对象地址，但运行时 generation 不同，没有把两者记录混在一起。
case.limits_zh: 准确 client 源码99356800e90aa0e7b604f652d714ef0f33422b47 使用缓存 CPython3.14.3、PostgreSQL17.1 和 pure-Python libpq，原报告为3.14.8/18.4。checkout 从已安装发行元数据读取3.3.9，不代表验证了发行版3.3.9。Connection 与上下文管理器 wrapper 身份依赖额外 API 观察，不能从 Task 父子关系推断共享资源，也没有捕获隐藏的 AsyncTransaction 对象身份。提交辅助函数为此独立 harness 增加。报告已说明事务栈清理根因，新增证据是历史 caller 与跨阶段资源状态。保留 b14、b15 各一次取消前的观察器失败；成功场景仅一次，未测嵌套 savepoint、多服务器/实现/版本、修复或重放。 此归因组件把后续复用块放入独立 Task，原报告是在 main 内直接执行；不声称复现原生产任务结构。

verification.version_note: Checkout version.py reads importlib.metadata from the cached installed distribution. This is an exact checkout test, not a released3.3.9 behavior claim.
limitations: Exact affected client checkout; cached Python3.14.3/PostgreSQL17.1/pure-Python libpq differ from reported3.14.8/18.4.
API observers supply Connection and context-manager wrapper identity/depth. Generic Task ancestry does not infer connection sharing or hidden transaction-object identity.
The factory helpers are introduced for this harness. No original application entry is claimed.
The source already explains transaction-stack cleanup. Added facts are historical Task callers and explicitly observed shared-connection state across phases.
Exception records may be propagation observations; distinct exception object identities were not captured.
One successful scenario only; no nested-savepoint, server/version/implementation matrix, fix or replay.
The later reuse block runs in a separate Task for this controlled attribution component; the original report runs that block inline in main. No original production Task topology is claimed.
